rows.text: We now expect adjusted diluted earnings per share* of $0.86 to $0.88, an increase of approximately 12% to 14% from Fiscal Year 2025, compared to our prior guidance of $0.84 to $0.87.

For Fiscal Year 2026, Hayward continues to expect net sales to increase approximately 5% from Fiscal Year 2025 and adjusted diluted earnings per share* of $0.84 to $0.87, an increase of approximately 9% to 13% from Fiscal Year 2025.
